purpose: Map simulator behavior to a second geometric album-cover detail set before image generation.

baseRule.composition: wide 3:2 top-down drone, large centered subject, full-bleed background
baseRule.background: large interlocking color fields, crisp arcs, bands, chevrons, grids, or contour geometry; no literal scenery
baseRule.subject: preserve the same enclosed-propeller drone, four guards, four propellers, central body, camera, and two outer LED paths
baseRule.finish: controlled matte texture, crisp edges, refined color blocking, no 3D product render

basic.geometry: simple aligned blocks and one dominant band

composition.geometry: nested zones, measured separators, and precise alignment marks

motion.geometry: directional rails, arrows, chevrons, and offset bands

rainbow.geometry: ordered spectrum strips and rotating color blocks

trails.geometry: tapered streaks, nested chevrons, and diminishing bars

ambience.geometry: broad layered fields and calm contour arcs

flashes.geometry: broken rays, hard-edged bursts, and separated markers

waves.geometry: nested arcs, contour bands, and repeated wave lines

styles.geometry: motifs chosen from the named style while retaining the same geometric album language

effectSolid.behavior: uniform full-strip illumination in one source-frame color
effectSolid.geometry: one broad continuous rectangular band behind the drone

effectStudySegment.behavior: bounded study segment with a controlled envelope and contrasting zone
effectStudySegment.geometry: two measured panels separated by a thin alignment line

effectPlanSegment.behavior: planned bounded segment with a controlled motion envelope
effectPlanSegment.geometry: stacked planning bars and a precise progress bracket

effectChase.behavior: one bright moving head with a short dim tail
effectChase.geometry: one luminous chevron head followed by two shorter rails

effectRainbow.behavior: continuous spectral progression distributed along the outer paths
effectRainbow.geometry: ordered spectrum tiles following a circular orbit

effectMeteor.behavior: one concentrated bright head followed by a fading directional tail
effectMeteor.geometry: one large diamond head with stepped taper bars

effectMeteorRain.behavior: several staggered bright heads with separate fading tails
effectMeteorRain.geometry: repeated diagonal diamonds with descending bar lengths

effectFire.behavior: warm irregular flicker with clustered hot spots and darker gaps
effectFire.geometry: offset ember polygons and uneven contour bands

effectIceFire.behavior: continuous upper ice-cyan to violet transition to lower ember-orange progression
effectIceFire.geometry: stacked flowing ribbons divided into cool upper and warm lower fields

effectLightning.behavior: sparse abrupt bright impulses along the outer paths
effectLightning.geometry: broken angular zigzags and isolated white-blue nodes

effectPulse.behavior: broad brightness pulse expanding from the center
effectPulse.geometry: nested rectangular rings with one bright active crest

effectCenterExpand.behavior: symmetric wavefront expanding outward from the center
effectCenterExpand.geometry: three nested rings with the outer ring emphasized

effectCenterContract.behavior: symmetric wavefront contracting toward the center
effectCenterContract.geometry: three nested rings with the inner ring emphasized

effectDampedRebound.behavior: bright wave crest rebounding with decreasing amplitude
effectDampedRebound.geometry: nested arcs that shrink in height toward the edges

effectTendril.behavior: thin organic tendril growing and bending along the path
effectTendril.geometry: one articulated curved ribbon with joint markers

effectBubble.behavior: several rounded luminous bubbles moving along the path
effectBubble.geometry: overlapping circles with stepped motion offsets

effectBreathe.behavior: whole pattern breathing smoothly between dim and bright
effectBreathe.geometry: concentric soft-edged frames with repeated spacing

effectFade.geometry: long parallel strips with measured opacity steps

effectDirectionalTrail.behavior: directional head with a tapered trail
effectDirectionalTrail.geometry: arrowhead plus progressively shorter trailing bars

effectDirectionalWipe.behavior: sharp directional boundary wiping across the strip
effectDirectionalWipe.geometry: one diagonal cut line followed by a solid field

effectDirectionalTendril.behavior: single directional tendril with elongated organic trail
effectDirectionalTendril.geometry: long curved ribbon with repeated angular joints

effectMultiChase.behavior: multiple evenly spaced chase heads moving together
effectMultiChase.geometry: three repeated chevrons aligned on parallel rails

effectMultiChaseTail.behavior: multiple chase heads with visible fading tails
effectMultiChaseTail.geometry: three chevrons each followed by stepped taper bars

effectWave.behavior: smooth sinusoidal brightness wave traveling along the paths
effectWave.geometry: repeated curved contour lines with one bright crest

effectDualWave.behavior: two contrasting traveling waves occupying separate color bands
effectDualWave.geometry: paired offset contour systems with a central divider

effectSparkle.behavior: many small single-color sparkle points with uneven density
effectSparkle.geometry: scattered diamond markers around a clean grid

effectColorSparkle.behavior: small sparkle points with varied source-frame hues
effectColorSparkle.geometry: multicolor marker clusters arranged on offset diagonals

effectTwinkle.behavior: warm star-like points varying in brightness
effectTwinkle.geometry: small four-point stars and isolated circular markers

effectComet.behavior: one comet head with a long smooth fading tail
effectComet.geometry: bright circle head with a long tapered orbital rail

effectBounce.behavior: one bright block bouncing between the two ends
effectBounce.geometry: mirrored end brackets connected by a travel line

effectBounceTail.behavior: bouncing head with a fading trail
effectBounceTail.geometry: end bracket, bright chevron, and reversed taper bars

effectTheaterChase.behavior: regular separated marquee blocks with chase rhythm
effectTheaterChase.geometry: evenly spaced marquee rectangles and a stepped border

effectGradient.behavior: smooth gradient slowly rolling along the strip
effectGradient.geometry: large parallel color panels with a clean interpolation seam

effectStack.behavior: ordered bands rising or shifting in layers
effectStack.geometry: stacked horizontal cards with one highlighted layer

effectScanner.behavior: narrow bright scanning bar crossing a dim field
effectScanner.geometry: thin luminous rail with a rectangular scan window

effectRipple.behavior: concentric brightness ripples spreading from a center point
effectRipple.geometry: nested square and circular rings with increasing spacing

effectPlasma.behavior: organic plasma modulation with smooth local variation
effectPlasma.geometry: interleaved rounded cells and contour loops

effectStrobe.behavior: full-strip hard on/off flash with crisp states
effectStrobe.geometry: high-contrast split panels and a sharp rectangular flash frame

effectColorWipe.behavior: solid color front wiping across the strip with a sharp boundary
effectColorWipe.geometry: large diagonal wipe plane and a hard dividing edge

effectRainbowWave.behavior: traveling hue and brightness wave with local crest modulation
effectRainbowWave.geometry: layered color wave bands with repeated angular crests

styleCyberpunk.behavior: neon cyan and magenta cyberpunk bands
styleCyberpunk.geometry: angular neon rails, scan brackets, and offset grids

styleVaporwave.behavior: lavender, cyan, and pink retro color fields
styleVaporwave.geometry: sunset disk, diagonal grid, and clean rounded blocks

styleOcean.behavior: deep blue and turquoise calm ocean flow
styleOcean.geometry: layered wave contours and horizon bands

styleLava.behavior: deep red, ember orange, and molten yellow heat bands
styleLava.geometry: angular magma plates and bright fissure lines

styleForest.behavior: layered forest green and fresh lime fields
styleForest.geometry: leaf-like polygons and branching contour lines

styleAurora.behavior: teal, green, and violet aurora ribbons
styleAurora.geometry: tall curved ribbons crossing a dark horizon grid

styleSunset.behavior: coral, orange, violet, and indigo sunset bands
styleSunset.geometry: horizontal horizon blocks and thin sun arcs

styleGalaxy.behavior: deep indigo and violet cosmic color fields
styleGalaxy.geometry: orbital ellipses, star points, and polygonal constellations

styleNeon.behavior: electric cyan and hot magenta neon bands
styleNeon.geometry: glowing outlined rectangles and diagonal light rails

styleCandlelight.behavior: warm amber and deep brown candlelight fields
styleCandlelight.geometry: nested warm halos and small geometric flame facets

styleMoonlight.geometry: crescent arcs, quiet grids, and long horizontal bands

styleArcade.geometry: pixel-like rectangles, score bars, and stepped borders without text

styleMatrix.behavior: dark green and acid-green code-like bands
styleMatrix.geometry: vertical modular columns and falling rectangular glyph blocks without literal text

styleHeartbeat.geometry: angular pulse line and nested red panels

stylePolice.behavior: upper outer path red and lower outer path blue, then swapped; inactive path remains dark in each state
stylePolice.geometry: two complementary red-blue panels and two offset dashed arcs; never alternate every LED around the full perimeter

styleChristmas.behavior: red and green festive light groupings
styleChristmas.geometry: stepped ribbon, small star polygons, and restrained ornament circles
